'''Wolves''' are [[Carn]]'s animal guards during the [[Fremennik Saga]], [[Three's Company]]. Three wolves appear in the saga and they are always accompanied by [[Bandit (Three's Company)|Bandits]]. They are only aggressive to the characters that the player is not controlling during the saga.
